scope: Research acquisition ledger; not automatic approval to change CAD dimensions.

sources.title: 1994 Ford EVTM public sample
sources.reviewed_finding: A 33-page public preview of the 1994 Bronco/F-Series EVTM was captured. Prefer the separate licensed-publisher sample for citation.
sources.limitations: The full publication was not downloaded. Affiliate and publisher page counts disagree.

sources.title: Forel EVTM publisher listing
sources.reviewed_finding: Forel lists product D21940, the 1994 Bronco/F-Series EVTM, at $21.95 on the research date. The listing links Demo21940.pdf.
sources.applicability: Acquisition metadata, not a technical specification.
sources.limitations: Publisher listing says 140 pages; affiliate listing says 379. Verify scope before buying. No purchase made.

sources.title: 1994 Ford PC/ED publication listing
sources.reviewed_finding: Identifies Ford PC/ED publication FPS1210694A, approximately 4,500 pages, listed at $129.98. Contents include the EEC-IV truck supplement, Quick Test, pinpoint tests and intermittent faults.
sources.limitations: No complete freely downloadable exact 1994 PC/ED was confirmed. Technical contents have not been inspected from this listing.

sources.title: 1994 service manual reprint listing
sources.reviewed_finding: Lists the 1994 truck two-volume service reprint: FPS-12107-94-1 and FPS-12107-94-2, ISBN 9781791419578, 3,952 pages, Detroit Iron 2023 reprint.
sources.applicability: Includes F-150 and other Ford trucks; acquisition lead.
sources.limitations: Not downloaded as a complete publication. Local HTML remains authoritative for this listing because automatic extraction is incomplete.

sources.title: 1980-89 Ford master parts catalog sample
sources.authority: Licensed publisher reproduction of Ford catalog
sources.reviewed_finding: A 251-page sample identifies text FPS8472-A and illustrations FPS8472-B. It offers exploded diagrams and part-number interpretation.
sources.applicability: 1980–1989 applications; March 1994 final issue is a publication date, not 1994 vehicle coverage.
sources.limitations: Shared parts require independent 1994 fitment verification. This is not a complete 1994 parts catalog.

sources.title: Gates 2011 Water Pumps catalog
sources.reviewed_finding: PDF page 55 (printed 35) assigns 44009 to 1993–96 F-Series 4.9L; earlier 1987–92 uses 44007. PDF page 199 (printed 179) cross-references F6TZ8501KB to 44009.
sources.applicability: Exact year/engine family application and agreement with existing Ford parts index.
sources.limitations: Photos and generic pump cutaway do not establish mounting coordinates, hub height, or exact internal geometry.

sources.title: Dorman 2006 OE Solutions manufacturer catalog
sources.reviewed_finding: PDF page 241 (printed 239) gives 594-152 diameter 6.42 inches and width 2.8 inches, with photo and 1987–96 Ford 4.9L application.
sources.applicability: Applicable replacement damper envelope, not proof of installed original part.
sources.limitations: Bore, keyway, axial offsets and elastomer profiles remain unknown. Old cross-reference F7TZ6312-A conflicts with current Dorman E7TZ6312-A.

sources.title: Dorman 594-152 current manufacturer page
sources.reviewed_finding: Dorman identifies 594-152 as a serpentine damper and lists OE E7TZ6312-A. It describes cast iron construction, a keyway, and one mounting hole.
sources.applicability: Replacement identification; current page and older catalog both include the target era.
sources.limitations: Current page lacks the diameter/width values; those come from the 2006 catalog. Conflicting hardware wording is not a component inventory.

sources.title: Melling camshaft specifications
sources.reviewed_finding: PDF page 13: SYB-38 hydraulic flat-tappet stock replacement. Intake/exhaust each 192 degrees at .050, 270 advertised; .247-inch cam lift, .395-inch valve lift; 1.6 rocker ratio; centerlines 108/114.
sources.applicability: SYB-38 application independently confirmed in manufacturer lookup for 1994 F-150 4.9L.
sources.limitations: These values constrain motion but do not specify complete lobe curves, journal stations or casting geometry.

sources.title: Melling pushrod specifications
sources.reviewed_finding: PDF page 1: MPR-306 is 10.140 inches long, .312-inch diameter, drilled welded steel, H&H ends. The illustrated table defines the length and end types.
sources.applicability: Standard-size replacement confirmed in manufacturer vehicle lookup, quantity 12.
sources.limitations: Ball radii, wall thickness, installed angle and lifter/rocker datums remain unresolved.

sources.title: Melling stock valve identification chart
sources.reviewed_finding: PDF page 1: V1504 exhaust head 1.559 inches, high-alloy steel. PDF page 4: V1505 intake head 1.783 inches, stainless steel.
sources.applicability: Both appear in manufacturer vehicle lookup, but its injection-pump gear-tower exception is anomalous for this gasoline engine.
sources.limitations: Reconcile application note with Ford valve specifications before CAD promotion. This chart does not supply complete stem/head profiles.

sources.title: Melling valve spring kit specifications
sources.reviewed_finding: Downloaded spring-kit table concerns other/performance kits and does not contain VS-2215 or VS-2216.
sources.applicability: Not applicable to stock springs identified for this engine.
sources.limitations: Do not borrow these spring dimensions for the engine. Keep as a documented rejected lead.

sources.title: Melling Ford truck application table at RPM
sources.reviewed_finding: Older Ford application table supplied search leads including M-74, SYB-38, MPR-306, V1504/V1505 and MPE-107R. Manufacturer live lookup subsequently confirmed the main part numbers.
sources.applicability: Lead only; merged rows and anomalous valve notes make it unsuitable as sole technical authority.
sources.limitations: Prefer saved manufacturer table and primary dimensional PDFs. Do not infer all catalog alternatives are installed simultaneously.

sources.title: Melling specification lookup
sources.reviewed_finding: Provides downloadable dimensional tables for camshafts, pushrods, valves and spring kits. Separate application lookup is https://melling.mypartfinder.com/.
sources.applicability: Discovery entry point; downloaded tables have stable individual source records.
sources.limitations: Portal HTML alone does not establish fitment or contain all product specifications.

sources.title: 1994 EVTM licensed publisher sample
sources.authority: Licensed publisher reproduction of Ford publication
sources.reviewed_finding: 35-page preview identifies FPS-12128-94 and ISBN 9781603714525. PDF page 6 indexes 4.9L controls at cell 23, ignition 21, starting 20, vacuum 140, connector faces 150 and locations 151–152.
sources.applicability: Exact model-year publication and useful diagram conventions.
sources.limitations: Contents list describes the full book, not all pages included in the sample. Full EVTM still needs acquisition.

sources.title: Melling 2026 expansion plug guide
sources.reviewed_finding: PDF page 10 (printed 8): MPE-107R contains five MPS-126, one MPC-147, one MPS-59A and two MPP-554. Dimensional tables on PDF pages 3 and 7–9 describe these component plugs.
sources.applicability: Kit application confirmed in live lookup for 1994 F-150 4.9L.
sources.limitations: Kit contents are not a complete engine BOM. Plug locations, cup wall thickness and seating depths require further evidence. MPS-59-A inch/metric OD columns disagree slightly; preserve original values.

sources.title: Melling 1994 F-150 4.9L manufacturer application lookup
sources.restore_method: Reapply filters from inventory/engine/melling-1994-49-applications.json; dynamic results are not recoverable by fetching the root URL.
sources.reviewed_finding: Selected 1994 / Ford / F-150 / 4.9L L6 / Stock / All Products and reviewed all 27 entries. Saved part numbers, catalog quantities, alternatives and anomalous valve notes in a structured transcription.
sources.applicability: Year/model/engine-specific catalog fitment. Does not establish what is physically installed in this truck.
sources.limitations: Includes service tools, repair liners, kits and alternatives. Do not sum quantities into an engine BOM. Valve application exception needs reconciliation.

capture_policy: Local reference originals and kb/.raw text are gitignored. Source summaries, reviewed claims and hashes are versionable. Public documents only; no purchases.
